 "rationale": "Two gain stages give about 65 dB with long L. GBW = gm1/(2*pi*Cc): 20 uA tail and Cc = 10 pF give about 2.4 MHz. gm7 of about 2.7 mS (about 190 uA) puts p2 near 1.8*GBW. Rz is set so the LHP zero cancels p2, which gives PM above 60 deg. Total current is 10 + 20 + 190 uA = 220 uA, about 400 uW."}

PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (15, 10, 20),       # input pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.3, 2.0),    # input pair L
    "itail": (20e-6, 10e-6, 40e-6),
    "gmid7": (13, 8, 15),        # PMOS load / 2nd-stage gm/Id (same -> no systematic offset)
    "Lp":    (0.8, 0.4, 2.0),    # PMOS L (M3, M4, M7)
    "i7":    (190e-6, 100e-6, 230e-6),
    "Ln":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),    # NMOS current-source L
    "cc":    (10e-12, 4e-12, 20e-12),
    "kz":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),    # Rz scale relative to p2-cancelling value
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 100e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    it, i7, cc = p["itail"], p["i7"], p["cc"]

    # Input pair (NMOS), PMOS mirror load
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], it / 2, vds=0.6)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid7"], p["Lp"], it / 2, vds=0.6)
    # Second stage: PMOS CS, same gm/Id and L as M3 so Vgs7 = Vgs3
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmid7"], p["Lp"], i7, vds=0.9)
    # NMOS bias mirrors (all same gm/Id, L as the diode)
    mb = lut.size("n", 10, p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.7)
    m5 = lut.size("n", 10, p["Ln"], it, vds=0.35)
    m8 = lut.size("n", 10, p["Ln"], i7, vds=0.9)

    gm1, gm7 = m1.gm, m7.gm
    rz = p["kz"] * (1 + cl / cc) / gm7     # LHP zero placed on p2

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M1", "x", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)   # vinn -> diode side
    n.dev("M2", "y", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)   # vinp -> output side (non-inverting overall)
    n.dev("M3", "x", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "y", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "y", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.R("RZ", "y", "z", rz)
    n.C("CC", "z", "vout", cc)

    # Predictions
    a1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    a2 = gm7 / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(a1 * a2)
    gbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cc)
    c1 = m7.cgg + 2 * m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    p2 = gm7 * cc / (2 * PI * (c1 * (cc + cl) + cc * cl))
    wz = 1.0 / (cc * (rz - 1.0 / gm7)) if rz > 1.0 / gm7 else -gm7 / cc
    fz = wz / (2 * PI)
    p3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * rz * c1) if c1 > 0 else 1e12
    pmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * 2 * m3.cgg)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / p2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / fz)) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / p3)) - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / pmir)) / 2
    vdd = 1.8
    power = vdd * (iref + it + i7)
    slew = min(it / cc, i7 / (cl + cc))
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": gbw, "pm": pm, "power": power, "slew": slew}
